biotools.summary: Free Windows desktop application that detects antimicrobial resistance genes and resistance mutations in bacterial isolate genomes from FASTA assemblies or FASTQ reads. It combines quality control, assembly, taxonomic classification, annotation, MLST typing and several resistance detectors (AMRFinderPlus, ABRicate, RGI with CARD, PointFinder, KMA) in a single workflow that runs locally, without the command line. Research use; not a clinical diagnostic.

function.note: FASTQ reads go through quality control and assembly; FASTA assemblies go directly to genome description and resistance detection.
